reason: A WebUI navigation plugin that opens specified conversations or workspaces from URL deep links and optionally keeps the address bar synchronized with the current conversation.

summaries.zh: 通过 URL 深链直接打开指定的对话或工作区，并可选择让地址栏跟随当前对话。
summaries.en: Opens specified conversations or workspaces through URL deep links and can optionally keep the address bar synchronized with the current conversation.

capabilities: Reads session and workspace identifiers from URL parameters
Switches the WebUI to a specified conversation or workspace
Updates the browser address bar using history.replaceState
Registers a model prompt section describing available deep links
